hero.title: Knit and woven garments, sewn to your size spec.
hero.description: We grade, sample and cut seasonal styles. After the fit sample is signed, bulk goes out by colour and size on the purchase order.
hero.imageAlt: Apparel sample studio with hanging garments

assurances.title: Fit sample before cutting
assurances.description: Base size signed on the garment

audiences.title: Who sends us a style.
audiences.description: A brand locking a block, a retailer filling a size run, and an agent booking capacity are buying three different jobs.

items.title: Brands
items.description: Keep next season on last season’s block and the same sewing line.

items.title: Retailers
items.description: Private-label tops and uniforms with store sizes, hangtags and carton marks on the PO.

items.title: Agents
items.description: Sewing slots you can date, plus measurement reports your principals will accept.

items.title: Product developers
items.description: Fit comments stay on the marked sample, not in a chat thread.

capabilities.title: Pattern room, sewing floor, packing bench.
capabilities.description: Construction and trims go on the style sheet before markers are cut. The bulk garment is cut from the block you approved.

items.title: Style sheet & fabric lot
items.description: Seam types, trim cards and fabric lots written before the marker is made.

items.title: Grading
items.description: XS–4XL from a base size. We ship the base fit sample, and a size set if you ask.

items.title: Proto, fit, PP
items.description: Bulk markers stay locked until the PP sample is signed.

items.title: Carton packing
items.description: Polybag, inner pack, carton mark and a counted packing list at final audit.

process.title: How a style reaches bulk.
process.description: Most delay sits between a reference photo and a signed PP. These steps close that gap.

steps.title: Send the style
steps.description: Tech pack, or a reference garment with fabric, size range and quantity.

steps.title: Pick the line
steps.description: Knit or woven, by construction and monthly volume.

steps.title: Sign the fit
steps.description: Comments on the sample. Cutting waits for that signature.

steps.title: Sew the PO
steps.description: Inline measurements by colour and size.

steps.title: Count the cartons
steps.description: AQL, packing list and export papers leave with the goods.

testimonials.quote: The size set matched our store chart. We did not regrade after the first drop.
testimonials.author: Northline Retail · Germany

testimonials.quote: PP comments were written on the sample photos. Bulk came back on that block.
testimonials.author: Harbor Agency · USA

warranty.title: What we do when a size or stitch fails.
warranty.description: The signed fit sample and the PO are the reference — not a conversation after the container leaves.
warranty.commitment: Measurement claims are checked against the signed size spec and the AQL sheet in the carton.

cases.question: If bulk fit drifts
cases.title: Hold the PO or rework against the signed sample.
cases.description: Cutting starts after fit approval. Out-of-tolerance sizes are pulled before packing.

cases.question: If shrinkage exceeds the spec
cases.title: Wash test before PP.
cases.description: Fabric and garment wash results sit on the style sheet. Failed lots stay off the cutting ticket.

cases.question: If a carton is short
cases.title: The packing list is the count.
cases.description: Every carton is counted at final audit. Shortage claims follow that list.

ecosystem.title: Sewing capacity in Shaoxing and Guangzhou.
ecosystem.description: Jersey and fleece on knit lines. Shirts, outerwear and uniforms on woven lines.

cta.title: Send a tech pack or a reference garment.
cta.description: Style, fabric, size range and quantity are enough. We reply with a factory, an MOQ and a sampling date.
cta.formDescription: Attach a tech pack, a size chart or a photo of the reference style.
steps: Send the style file or the garment.
Get a factory, MOQ and a sampling date.
Sign the fit sample before we cut bulk.
